selected.title: Russian fintech A7 exploited Swift controls to funnel billion of dollars in sanctioned payments
selected.summary: An FT investigation has uncoverd a massive money laundering scam conducted by Kremlin-controlled fintech A7 that tricked international banks into handling billions of dollars in sanction-busting payments to Russian state companies.
selected.why: Major investigation reveals multi-billion-dollar sanctions evasion exploiting Swift and international banking controls.

reason: Sanctions evasion via fintech reveals whether current controls architecture is fundamentally broken or merely needs enforcement upgrades
angle: Financial regulation must choose between redesigning cross-border payment infrastructure or accepting that determined actors will always find workarounds.
